item.title: A compact fibre-fed echelle spectrograph for small telescopes
item.description: arXiv:0000.00001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe the optical design and first light of a low-cost echelle spectrograph fed by a multimode fibre, built for 0.5 m class telescopes. The instrument reaches a resolving power of about 20000 over 400-700 nm.
item.dc:creator: A. Rao, B. Singh, C. Massey

item.title: Automated flat-field correction for CMOS sensors in amateur spectroscopy
item.description: arXiv:0000.00002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a pipeline that builds master flats for CMOS cameras and test it on slitless spectra of bright stars.
item.dc:creator: D. Kulkarni, E. Shah
